title: Breadcrumbs
description: Where you are, as a path. The last crumb is the page itself — not a link.
usage: For hierarchies three levels or deeper. Keep crumb names short; if the path gets long, collapse the middle on small screens rather than wrapping.
a11y: A <nav> with an ordered list; the current page is plain text with aria-current="page". Separators are decorative.
